title: OpenRouter Inference API key: one-property twin (length)
summary: 3 inputs are identical to a positive input except for one change: the value's length differs from the contracted length. Legacy mutation notes: length: 32 hex characters, half the documented 64, length: 63 hex characters vs the documented 64, and length: 65 hex characters vs the documented 64. Twin of "OpenRouter Inference API key: must be flagged (provider-documented) [legacy tier T1]".
rationale: A twin changes exactly one property, so the expected outcome differs from the positive for that one reason. Reporting the twin is a false alarm, and it shows that the changed property is part of what identifies the credential.

expectation.rationale: Negative twin of openrouter-api-key-bearer-header: length: 65 hex characters vs the documented 64. Exactly one structural property differs from the positive; silence follows from construction.
